messages:
Sam: quick design ping  proposal: add a compatibility summary to the autofallback composer so operators can't enable incompatible fallbacks. want opinions.
Ivy: yes. what checks you thinking? api contract, token length, model outputs shape, and quota/headroom.
Arjun: add a simple risk score too (0-10) so we can surface high-risk fallbacks in red. compute from mismatch count + traffic pct.
Kira: UX idea: compact row per target with badges: API_OK, TOKENS_OK, QUOTA_OK, EST_LATENCY(+/-). clicking row expands samples and sample-diff.
Sam: good. also include a one-click "generate adapter" if only token-length or missing fields are an issue. adapter shows small transform code.
Ivy: audit policy: every enable must record event_id, policy_id, compatibility_checks (pass/fail), operator, reservation_id (if used). store small redacted input sample.
Arjun: fallback-bot should announce when enabled: include event link and a short justification string. fallback-bot: autofallback afb-2100200000 enabled by Sam. audit://afb-2100200000
Kira: question: for shared hosted fallback we might hit rate limits. composer should warn and optionally queue a soft-reservation.
Sam: agreed. if reservation fails we show a blocking modal with alternatives. can we add a "preview in sandbox" button that runs the preflight on a copied traffic window?
Ivy: preview button is useful. make sure preview snapshots are ephemeral and logged with a snapshot_id.
Arjun: security: any preview or sample that includes PII should be redacted by default and require a second confirmation to view.
Kira: i'll mock the row + badges and a small adapter modal. can review after lunch?
Sam: perfect. thanks team. i'll wire an initial API payload for these checks and drop in the design thread.
